crossRefs.note: David called one of the young men, and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…
For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to…
He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them on the mountain before Yahweh, and all seven…
If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,
his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for he who is hanged is…
They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Ish-bosheth
people.line: Son of Saul, king over Israel.

translations.web: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried it in Abner’s grave in Hebron.
translations.bsb: So David commanded his young men, and they killed Rechab and Baanah. They cut off their hands and feet and hung their bodies by the pool in Hebron, but they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in Abner’s tomb in Hebron.
translations.kjv: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.
translations.asv: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-bosheth, and buried it in the grave of Abner in Hebron.
